### New in 1.5.1
- **Targeting Nearest Platform & Block**: Pets now intelligently navigate each page by calculating proximity and jumping only to the nearest platform or block (closest shelf on Home, closest to-do card on To-do page), eliminating random screen-crossing jumps.
- **Bird Flight & Perching**: The pet bird companion now takes flight, swooping and gliding gracefully through the air across screens with dynamic flapping wings, before smoothly descending to perch on the nearest shelf, block, or floor with cheerful chirping.
- **Realistic Animal Leg Movement**: Overhauled animal leg animations across all companions (Cat, Dog, Rabbit, Bird). Replaced horizontal sliding with realistic joint-pivoted hip and shoulder rotations, quadruped diagonal trot gaits, articulated paws with swing-phase lift, cute springy bunny hops, and tucked legs during bird flight.

### Install / update
Download `shelfwise.apk` below and open it. It installs over older versions and keeps everything.
